# Karni

> Karni is an open-source Django + React framework for building with AI coding agents. Your agent writes only your domain: the API, admin, permissions and React screens come from a package you upgrade, not code it rewrites in each project. One rule set covers Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot; the build fails when an agent hand-writes what Karni ships.

The site is https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/ and the source is https://github.com/cbsshekhawat18-lab/karni. Python 3.12+, Django 5.2 LTS, React 18, TypeScript.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/quickstart/): install `karni` and `karni-cli`, run `karni new`, add a model and see the API, admin and UI appear.
- [Tutorial — build EventHub](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/tutorial/): the reference application (ticketing, payments, Celery, four roles) in 593 lines of project code.
- [Building with an AI agent](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/guide/with-ai/): how Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot drive a Karni project through the generated adapter files, `karni context`, `karni rules` and `karni explain`.
- [Building without an AI agent](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/guide/without-ai/): the same workflow by hand, command by command.

## Main concepts

- [Models](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/models/): `BaseModel` (UUID keys, timestamps, audit fields, soft delete) and scopes.
- [The API](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/api/): `BaseViewSet` plus the `access` declaration — one predicate compiled into the request gate and the row filter; filtering, search, pagination, `?expand=`, an N+1-free query plan, the OpenAPI document.
- [Permissions at the queryset](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/concepts/queryset-permissions/): why a row outside the scope is a 404, never a 403.
- [Accounts](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/accounts/): email login, JWT or sessions, one-time tokens, 2FA, social login, roles as data (`KARNI_ROLES`, `user.can()`, `Can("app.model:action")`).
- [Admin](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/admin/): every model gets a derived django-unfold admin.
- [@karni/ui](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/ui/): schema-driven React components — ResourceTable, ResourceForm, ResourceDetail, auth, Layout.
- [Testing](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/testing/): `assert_crud` and `assert_isolated` prove a resource's whole surface and its isolation in two lines; query budgets fail tests on N+1.
- [Events and listeners](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/events/), [Scheduling](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/scheduling/), [Seeding](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/seeding/).
- [Enforcement](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/enforcement/): `karni check`, the ESLint preset and the architecture tests that keep generic code out of projects.
- [Karni for AI agents](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/karni/agents/): the generated AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / Cursor / Copilot adapters, slash commands and the MCP server.

## Reference

## Packages

- PyPI: `karni`, `karni-cli`, `karni-payments`. npm: `@karni/ui`, `@karni/payments-ui`. All released at one version.
